general.description: Carved in the surface of Deimos, the second moonlet of Mars, stand the main spaceport of the planet. Here, you can found classical way of travels in a spartiat cargo or coastership cabin, for a very reasonnable price, in comparaison with the the one applied in the slingshot-station of Dvarapala.
general.bar: Spacers, miners and traveller waiting for the next ship, sipping some cheap beer or even a bubble of Rockstealer's Fuel cocktail.
